items.title: Find your logging gaps before they become compliance gaps with CloudTrail Data Event Coverage
items.summary: AWS CloudTrail now includes a Data event coverage page in the AWS CloudTrail console, giving you a single view of how well your resources are covered by data event logging. CloudTrail records API activity across your AWS account for security auditing, compliance, and operational troubleshooting. Management events, the control-plane actions such as creating a bucket […]
